prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic post-workout gym portrait of an approved adult woman showing focused strength and self-confidence.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with a damp dark high ponytail, natural post-workout sheen, and focused expression. She wears a soft-pink athletic top and matching pink jogger sweatpants, standing by a gym mirror and touching palms with a workout partner or reflection.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical medium portrait with the subject and partial partner/reflection in frame. Include weight racks, machines, dumbbells, and a modern gym interior with realistic mirror depth.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm indoor gym lighting, realistic sweat and fabric texture, strong confident focused mood, motivating fitness atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic digital photography, vertical 4:5 framing, sharp subject and hands, natural perspective, accurate mirror reflection and gym equipment.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 4:5 post-workout gym portrait of an approved adult woman with a damp dark high ponytail, natural athletic sheen, and focused expression. She wears a soft-pink athletic top and matching pink jogger sweatpants, stands beside a gym mirror, and touches palms with a workout partner or her reflection. Include weight racks, machines, dumbbells, and realistic mirror depth in a modern gym. Use warm indoor lighting, accurate hands and reflections, realistic sweat and fabric texture, and a strong confident motivating mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, broken mirror reflection, malformed equipment
